.agents: Agent skill system: bootstrap, runtime, lang, test, package, wildcard, and tool lanes. The live taxonomy lives in .agents/skills/TAXONOMY.md.
.cargo: Cargo configuration for Rust tooling and cross-compilation targets used by the Kain compiler crates.
.kain: Kain binary installation root and local tooling: launchers, shims, and per-user Kain home directory.
.pi: pi coding agent configuration: user settings, extensions, themes, and session-local state.
attrition: Deterministic runtime abuse, sabotage, replay, telemetry, and teardown-closure certification. Run via python attrition/run.py.
benchmark: Performance truth lane across Kain, Rust, C++, Zig, Go, Erlang, JS, and Python. Run via python benchmark/run.py.
blades: Dogfood workspaces and reusable Kain libraries: demos, acceptance apps, UI, GPU, C/Python interop, networking, simulations, and experiments.
crates: Rust compiler crates: parser, AST, typechecker, diagnostics, LLVM codegen, CLI, actor/ownership/gpu/fs/net subsystems, selfhost, and driver.
docs: Documentation: language overview, quickstart, CLI reference, runtime guides, pipeline docs, and older support material.
ml: ML training pipeline: error corpus, semantic search embedding, tokenizer, CUDA kernels, and processed/generated datasets for the semantic oracle.
packages: External package bundles and overlays (e.g. py_kn for Python-package-aware Kain builds).
runtime: Native C runtime substrate: core services (actor, async, ownership, memory, entangle, graphics, Python, JSON, reflection), platform layer, and UI system.
scripts: Build, test, and automation scripts: Windows/PowerShell, Linux/WSL bash, Python tooling, and CI/CD helpers.
smoketest: Primary proving ground for Kain testing. Album-style workspace under smoketest/src plus adjacent smoke surfaces for capability and regression abuse.
stdlib: Canonical Kain standard library: 65+ modules, 3500+ public symbols covering math, os, json, gpu, graphics, fs, net, process, actors, interop, and more.
toolchain: LLVM and Rust toolchain configurations, rules_rust overlays, and cross-compilation target definitions.
tools: Operator tools: Bazel GUI, foreign ABI helpers, crash forensics, repo map generator, TypeScript import, native runtime inspection, and refactoring utilities.
unreal: Unreal Engine 5 integration: Kain-to-UE5 bridge, Blueprint extraction, GAS (Gameplay Ability System), asset utilities, config, editor, and material graph tooling.
z3: Durable Z3 proof packs and reports: solver-backed correctness evidence for runtime, compiler, and authored Kain subsystems.
